entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: A merfolk nation of nine tribes living on Ixalan, ancient stewards of Orazca and the nine tributaries of the Great River.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane and continent where the River Heralds live.

entities.name: Shapers
entities.description: Respected merfolk elders and leaders who guide their bands and summon elementals.

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: Great shaper and de jure leader of all River Herald bands, who summons the tribal congress.

entities.name: Deeproot Tree
entities.description: Ancient mangrove temple complex and the closest thing the River Heralds have to a capital; ravaged in the invasion.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city housing the Immortal Sun, of which the Heralds are stewards.

entities.name: The Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact housed in Orazca that was stolen.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: Empire kept out of the interior by the Heralds' strength long ago.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who besieged the Deeproot Tree.

entities.name: The New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that winnowed the River Heralds' numbers.

entities.name: Matzalantli
entities.description: A massive gilded city of stepped stone buildings above and below an underground freshwater ocean.

entities.name: Great Shaper Falani
entities.description: Great shaper killed in the Invasion.

entities.name: Great Shaper Mitica
entities.description: Great shaper killed in the Invasion.

entities.name: Great Shaper Notana
entities.description: Great shaper killed in the Invasion.

entities.name: Great Shaper Tuvasa
entities.description: Great shaper killed in the Invasion.

entities.name: Great Shaper Vuhana
entities.description: Great shaper killed in the Invasion.

events.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion hits the River Heralds hard; surviving bands flee to hidden places, most retreating to the Deeproot Tree.
events.quote: The New Phyrexian Invasion hit the River Heralds hard, winnowing their already small numbers down.

events.summary: The Heralds defend the Deeproot Tree through a terrible siege; Great Shapers Falani, Mitica, Notana, Tuvasa and Vuhana are killed.
events.quote: Great Shapers Falani, Mitica, Notana, Tuvasa , and Vuhana were killed in the Invasion.

events.summary: The Phyrexians are driven from the Deeproot Tree, leaving a polluted grave of a swamp.
events.quote: The Phyrexians would eventually be driven from the sacred site

events.summary: Without a unifying sacred site, the River Heralds' unity shatters and many resort to raids or serve other powers.
events.quote: Without a unifying sacred site, the River Heralds' fragile unity shattered.

events.summary: Tishana summons all merfolk to a tribal congress, the largest assembly of merfolk bands in Ixalan's history.
events.quote: summoned all merfolk who could hear her to the tribal congress so that they could decide together the fate of the plane

relations.note: De jure leader of all bands
relations.quote: de jure leader of all River Herald bands
The River Heralds are a merfolk nation living on the continent of Ixalan

relations.note: Resisted the siege of the Deeproot Tree
relations.quote: The River Heralds were able to resist the Phyrexians for some time
